description: Audit a Supabase/Postgres database's Row Level Security and return machine-readable structured JSON. Unlike audit_supabase_rls (which returns a human-readable summary), this tool returns findings grouped by severity with counts, suitable for programmatic consumption by an agent that needs to iterate over findings, generate fixes, or build a report. Same engine, same checks, different output shape.

allow.description: Policy names that are intentionally permissive. Prefer the qualified form "table.policy".

db_url.description: Postgres connection string for the project to audit (e.g. postgresql://... — a read-only role is enough).

name: get_findings
